item.title: Heritage Foundation Rates Space Force ‘Marginal’
item.description: “The Space Force is woefully short of the resources required to hold adversary space systems at risk, and is not ready to operate in a contested environment even though conflict with a major adversary will likely begin in space,” the report says. “While most of its current capabilities are highly effective in an uncontested environment, the Space Force lacks the capacity and capability to be ready for conflict in space.” The post Heritage Foundation Rates Space Force ‘Marginal’ appeared first on
